description: The shared Renovate preset of zeabur-oss: extend it with "github>zeabur-oss/.github". Commits sign off, as the DCO check requires of every commit.

packageRules.description: Every pin of zeabur-oss/.github moves to the same commit in one pull request, on the first run after a merge to its main: the shared workflows and actions, @zeabur-oss/release in package.json and the flake input in flake.lock.
